spans.s: व (1) the semivowel व्: see व्; (2) personal-ending substituted for वस् in the perfect ( लिट् ) first person (उत्तमपुरुष), and in the present tense in the case of the root विद्; cf. परस्मैपदानां णलतुसुस्० and विदो लटो वा.
,83; (3) krt affix क्विप् , क्विन् or वि of which only व् remains; cf. अनिगन्तोञ्चतौ वप्रत्यये

.the affix is mention- ed as वप्रत्यय by Panini, but, in fact, it is व् , अ being added for ease in pronunciation; (4) tad. affix in the sense of possession added along with the other affixes इन् , इक, and वत् to the word केश and to some other words such as मणि, हिरण्य, राजी, अर्णस् etc. as also to गाण्डी and अजग; cf.
वा a term often used in the sutras of Panini and others,' to show the optional application of a rule: cf. न वेति विभाषा
